{{Quote|They're a family of assassins, descended from an Exchange crime lord.|[[Jeral Vesk]], about House Rist|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Rist'''<ref name="Codex" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="House" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] in the [[Exchange]] crime syndicate who provided a number of illicit services to members of the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of dealing with the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]], the crime lord was granted his own lands on Alderaan, and his family was legitimized as [[House Rist]], a minor member of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]]. In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] that followed, Rist's descendants continued to be employed as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and criminals by the other houses.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
House Rist's progenitor was first mentioned in the Codex entry for his house in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
